entries.headline: US transports and widespread Saudi flight disruption reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple large US military transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and said attacks on Saudi airports caused dozens of deaths, widespread flight diversions and delays. The visible post is truncated thereafter.

entries.headline: Six US transports and continuing Saudi airport disruption reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne, including one over the North Sea, and said Saudi airports remained disrupted after Houthi attacks on a Riyadh terminal killed 12 people and injured 300.

entries.headline: US transports, elevated Mediterranean traffic and Saudi attacks reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US military transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States, Eastern Mediterranean air traffic at nearly four times normal and Houthi attacks on Saudi airports. The visible post is truncated after the word “major”.

entries.headline: US surveillance aircraft and Riyadh airport casualties reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a US Air Force surveillance aircraft operating over northern Saudi Arabia and said missile impacts at Riyadh airport killed 12 people and injured 300. The visible post is truncated after stating that multiple airports remained closed or otherwise affected.

entries.headline: Six US transports and Saudi airport attacks reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States and North Sea, and said attacks on Saudi airports killed 12 people and injured 300, with multiple aircraft diverted or holding.

entries.headline: Six heavy transports and Riyadh terminal casualties reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force heavy transport aircraft airborne, including one over the North Sea, and said Houthi missile strikes at a Riyadh airport terminal killed 12 people. The visible post is truncated after reporting injuries.

entries.headline: Six US transports, Riyadh casualties and Jeddah delays reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the North Sea and Baltic, and said a missile attack at Riyadh airport killed 12 people, injured 300 and diverted flights to Jeddah. The visible post is truncated after reporting major delays.

entries.headline: Riyadh casualties, Jeddah backlog and North Sea transports reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Houthi missile attack on a Riyadh airport terminal that killed 12 people and injured 300, with diverted flights backed up at Jeddah and US military transport aircraft active over the North Sea.

entries.headline: Six US cargo aircraft and Saudi airport crisis reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US military cargo aircraft airborne across the Atlantic, North Sea and Baltic, alongside a Saudi airport crisis following a Houthi missile attack on a Riyadh terminal. The visible post is truncated thereafter.

entries.headline: Riyadh Terminal 3 casualties, Jeddah diversions and US transports reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Houthi missile attack on Riyadh airport Terminal 3 that killed 12 people and injured 300, with all flights diverted to Jeddah and multiple US military transport aircraft airborne globally.

entries.headline: Four transports and Saudi airport disruption reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four US military transport aircraft airborne and said missile strikes closed Riyadh airport, killed 12 people and injured 300, while Jeddah and Dammam airports were disrupted by diverted flights. The visible post is truncated thereafter.

entries.headline: Four transports and Riyadh flight diversions reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four US military transport aircraft airborne and said missile impacts at Riyadh airport killed 12 people, injured 300 and forced flights to divert to Jeddah, where dozens were holding to land.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on Edgewing engineering hub in Turin
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a The Aviationist report that Edgewing opened an engineering centre in Turin, Italy, to support work on the Global Combat Air Programme.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on Turkish F-16 deployment to Latvia
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that Turkish Air Force F-16 aircraft were deployed to Lielvārde Air Base to support Latvian airspace security during parliamentary elections.
